Business Papers, Minutes and Recorded Live Streams

The Business Paper is available to the public and media by the Friday prior to the meeting date and can be downloaded below or obtained from the Council Office, 91 Adelaide Street during office opening hours.

Please note that the Business Papers and Minutes downloadable below, are available in Portable Document Format (PDF) and require Adobe Acrobat Reader to open them.  

View Business Papers and Minutes from previous years click here.

Council will, as required, hold the Public Forum at 5:30pm on the day of the Council Ordinary and Extraordinary Meetings, all the information and application forms for the Public Forums is available here.
